title: Wine Flask
description: Add  a vessel to hold and regenerate potions.
body:
# Introduction

This mod adds a portable container called the Wine Flask, which can be refilled and used to drink various potions repeatedly. It also supports two exclusive enchantments—"Capacity" and "Refill".

## Wine Flask
Can hold 1 potion (default capacity), right-click to drink.
Combine with the potions (standard/splash/linger type) in the crafting table to load, allowing multiple identical potions to be loaded at once.
A pot can only hold one type of potion at the same time.
You can find it in the "Tools and Utilities" category of the creative mode inventory.
Can be obtained by trading with the cleric villager (5 emeralds for 1 empty wine flask)

## Enchantments

**Capacity:**

Level I / II / III: Capacity increased to 3/6/9 units respectively.

**Refill (Highest Level I):**

The wine flask will automatically replenish 1 serving at regular intervals based on the duration of the effect of the potion in the bottle(three times the duration).
If only containing instant effects (such as Potion of Healing) - replenish 1 dose every 5 minutes.
The pot will automatically remember the last potion it was filled with and gradually restore the number of portions over time, even if all portions of potion in the pot have been drunk up.
Can only be obtained by trading with the librarian villager or found in naturally generated chests.
# 介绍

本模组添加了一种可重复使用的酒壶，能将药水装进去一次、分多次喝，还能通过附魔让酒壶自动再生药水。酒壶还有两个专属附魔——“扩容”和“药水再生”

## 酒壶
初始容量可装入一瓶药水，右键饮用
在工作台上与药水（支持喷溅型和滞留型药水）合成即可装入药水
一只酒壶同时只能装入同一种药水
创造模式下在“工具和实用物品”处可以找到酒壶
可以以5绿宝石的价格在牧师村民处购买

## 附魔

**扩容**

等级I / II / III：分别将酒壶的容量扩展到3瓶/6瓶/9瓶

**药水再生（最高等级I级）**

酒壶会记住并自动再生补充最后一次装过的药水（每份所需时长为药水效果时长的三倍），即使喝完了酒壶内的所有药水也依旧会再生
如果包含瞬间效果的药水（如瞬间治疗）则再生时长为5分钟一份
该附魔书只能在图书管理员村民处购买或通过自然生成的战利品宝箱获得
